objective:
Follow these steps literally, one at a time, from the current page. Click only what each step names. Never type a URL, search, or take another route.
Where to find them, in the tutorial's own words: "This will open the Book creator page; click Suggest pages, then Wikipedia The Free Encyclopedia to get started."
1. Click the element whose visible label is exactly 'Suggest pages'.
2. Click the element whose visible label is exactly 'Wikipedia The Free Encyclopedia'.
If the page you end on has a main heading, store it as 'landed_on'; a page without a heading is fine.
